library_name: Destiny Jedi Academy Heroic and Force Talents
notes: Complete Jedi-class and universal Force talent additions from the Jedi Academy Training Manual, with explicit tree and dependency data.

rules.name: Adversary Lore
rules.description: Read a nearby enemy's weaknesses through the Force and expose them to your allies.

mechanics.target: One creature within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: On success, the target takes -2 Reflex Defense against you and allies who can hear and understand you until the end of your next turn.

rules.name: Know Weakness
rules.description: Enemies exposed by Adversary Lore suffer extra damage from every successful allied attack.

mechanics.effect: Until the end of your next turn, the target takes +1d6 damage from every successful attack by you or an ally who can hear and understand you.

rules.name: Grenade Defense
rules.description: Hurl an incoming grenade harmlessly aside with the Force.

mechanics.use: Reaction when attacked by a grenade.
mechanics.check: Use the Force vs. the grenade's attack roll.
mechanics.effect: On success, redirect it to a harmless location and negate the attack.
mechanics.special: Whether successful or not, take -5 on Use the Force checks until the start of your next turn.

rules.name: Hold the Line
rules.description: A successful opportunity attack stops an enemy from leaving your reach.

mechanics.trigger: Hit a target with an attack of opportunity as it leaves your threatened area.
mechanics.effect: Immediately stop the target's movement and end the movement action.

rules.name: Master of the Great Hunt
rules.description: Specialized training makes you exceptionally deadly against dark-side beasts.

mechanics.target: A beast with Dark Side Score 1+.
mechanics.effect: Gain +1 Force bonus on attacks and +1 weapon-damage die with lightsaber attacks against it.

rules.name: Shoto Focus
rules.description: Fight more accurately with a shoto paired with a standard one-handed lightsaber.

special: Wield both a one-handed lightsaber and a shoto or guard shoto

mechanics.effect: Gain +2 competence bonus on attacks made with the shoto or guard shoto while wielding the pair.

rules.name: Illusion Bond
rules.description: See and hear from the position of a humanoid illusion you create.

mechanics.trigger: Create a humanoid illusion with Illusion.
mechanics.effect: You can see and hear as though standing in the illusion's space for its duration.

rules.name: Influence Savant
rules.description: Recover a spent mind-affecting Force power once each encounter.

mechanics.use: Swift action, once per encounter per selection.
mechanics.effect: Return one spent Force power with the mind-affecting descriptor to your suite without spending a Force Point.
mechanics.special: Each additional selection grants one additional use per encounter.

rules.name: Link
rules.description: Form a Force bond allowing two trained allies to assist each other's Force checks reactively.

mechanics.use: Standard action to link; free action for either participant to end.
mechanics.target: One willing ally trained in Use the Force within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: While within 12 squares, either participant may aid the other's Use the Force check as a reaction.
mechanics.cost: The assisting character takes -5 on all Use the Force checks until the end of their next turn.
mechanics.duration: Until encounter end, voluntarily ended, or range is broken; one active link at a time.

rules.name: Masquerade
rules.description: Turn an Illusion into a deceptive disguise covering your own appearance.

mechanics.effect: Use Illusion to disguise yourself; its Use the Force result becomes the deceptive-appearance result under the Deception skill, while all Illusion limits still apply.

rules.name: Suppress Force
rules.description: Spend Mind Trick reactively to convince another Force-user that its connection has failed.

mechanics.use: Reaction; expend one Mind Trick use.
mechanics.target: One Intelligence 3+ creature within 12 squares and line of sight attempting Use the Force.
mechanics.check: Your Use the Force vs. the target's Use the Force result.
mechanics.effect: On success, negate the target's check and the action it was attempting fails.

rules.name: Channel Energy
rules.description: Convert energy successfully absorbed with Negate Energy into an immediate Force power.

mechanics.trigger: Successfully negate damage from an energy-weapon attack using Negate Energy.
mechanics.effect: Immediately activate any Force power currently available in your suite.

rules.name: Force Harmony
rules.description: Use one Force-Point-powered talent freely each encounter.

mechanics.effect: Activate one Force talent that normally requires spending a Force Point without spending that point.

rules.name: Dark Side Savant
rules.description: Recover a spent dark-side Force power once each encounter.

mechanics.use: Swift action, once per encounter per selection.
mechanics.effect: Return one spent Force power with the dark-side descriptor to your suite without spending a Force Point.
mechanics.special: Each additional selection grants another use per encounter.

rules.name: Transfer Essence
rules.description: Manifest briefly as a dark spirit after death and attempt to possess a creature or object.

special: Dark Side Score equals Wisdom score

mechanics.effect: Become a dark spirit through encounter end. As a standard action, attack an adjacent creature's Will with Use the Force, dealing 8d6 stun; reducing it to 0 hp or the bottom condition step permits possession. Alternatively enter an adjacent object and attempt possession when someone uses it.
mechanics.duration: If no creature or object is possessed within 10 rounds, the spirit dissipates.

rules.name: Guardian Spirit
rules.description: Receive guidance and a daily reserve of Force energy from a watching spirit.

mechanics.effect: When using Search Your Feelings, consult the spirit to learn the nature of immediate consequences and whether an action advances your destiny. After 6 hours' rest, gain one bonus Force Point usable only to improve a Force power or activate a Force technique or secret.
mechanics.duration: Unused bonus point disappears at the start of the next day.

rules.name: Crucial Advice
rules.description: Your guardian spirit lets you retry one failed skill check with an advantage.

mechanics.use: Once per encounter after failing a skill check.
mechanics.effect: Reroll the check with +2 circumstance bonus and use the new result.
mechanics.special: For tiered checks, failure means not reaching the minimum DC.

rules.name: Manifest Guardian Spirit
rules.description: Manifest your guardian on the battlefield to reinforce your attacks, Force use, and resolve.

mechanics.use: Swift action; spend 1 Force Point. Move spirit up to 6 squares as a swift action once per turn.
mechanics.effect: While it remains within 12 squares, gain +1 morale on attacks, +2 morale on Use the Force, and +2 morale to Will Defense. It occupies a space but does not obstruct movement.

rules.name: Distracting Apparition
rules.description: A manifested guardian distracts and unsettles nearby enemies.

mechanics.effect: Enemies within 3 squares of the manifested spirit take -2 Will Defense and -2 on attacks against you.

rules.name: Vital Encouragement
rules.description: Your guardian urges you onward with a reserve of temporary vitality.

mechanics.effect: Gain bonus hit points equal to 10 + half heroic level; damage removes these first.
mechanics.duration: Unused bonus hit points disappear after the encounter.

rules.name: Instinctive Navigation
rules.description: Use the Force to astrogate and operate sensors while piloting.

mechanics.effect: While you are a vehicle's pilot, substitute Use the Force for Use Computer checks made to astrogate or operate sensors.

rules.name: Motion of the Future
rules.description: Spend Farseeing to glimpse an incoming attack and force the aggressor to try again.

mechanics.use: Swift action; remove one Farseeing use from your active suite.
mechanics.effect: Before the end of your next turn, when targeted by an attack or Force power, force the attacker to reroll its attack or Use the Force check and keep the second result.
mechanics.special: Counts as using Farseeing against that attacker but replaces Farseeing's normal effect.
